records.issue_text: When eventType.teamId is null the code checks team id 0
records.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` calls `isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)` and `isTeamOwner(... ?? 0)`. This explicitly passes `0` when `eventType.teamId` is `null/undefined`, which could lead to incorrect permission evaluation (or unintended lookup against team id 0) instead of skipping team checks when there is no team.

records.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, new attendees are persisted via prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...) before calling eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking). There is no transaction or compensating rollback. If updateCalendarAttendees throws, the DB now contains the added attendees but the calendar update didn’t occur. records.issue_text: prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { id: booking.userId || 0 } }): if booking.userId is null, a query for id 0 throws a raw Prisma error (unhandled → HTTP 500) instead of a proper TRPCError with a meaningful message
records.rationale: In new addGuests.handler.ts, organizer is fetched via prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { id: booking.userId || 0 } }). If booking.userId is null/undefined, this forces id=0; findFirstOrThrow will throw when no user exists, and the handler does not convert that into a TRPCError (it will bubble up as an unhandled Prisma error), leading to a 500 instead of a meaningful TRPC error.

records.issue_text: handleAdd silently returns when the email list is empty, giving no feedback that nothing happened; the Zod schema is also redefined inline in the component instead of importing the shared server schema, risking drift between client and server validation
records.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.handleAdd(), when multiEmailValue becomes an empty array (possible via MultiEmail’s remove button which splices entries), the function returns without any UI feedback. Also, the client defines its own Zod schema inline (including a uniqueness refine) instead of importing the server’s shared ZAddGuestsInputSchema from packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.
